modules.module_title: Follow preventive measures to control pests and disease

pcs.pc_description: use pest and disease-resistant varieties of cereals, ensuring their timely sowing, following the recommended hygiene practices in the field
carry out crop rotation with suitable crops
follow the recommended practices to restrict the entry of pathogens into the field through planting material, irrigation water, workers, tools and equipment, and vectors such as whitefly
identify and remove the diseased crop to prevent the spread of pests and diseases to healthy crop
use the recommended combination of cultural, biological, mechanical and chemical control methods for effective pest and disease prevention
follow the appropriate integrated pest management techniques like trash mulching, de- trashing, pest egg destruction, bund freeing, water draining, usage of bio-control agents, etc.

modules.module_title: Identify pests and diseases in cereal crop

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended Integrated Pest Management (IPM) methods such as light and pheromone traps to identify the presence and population of pests, insects and vectors such as stem borer, leaf folder, Fall Armyworm, Panicle mites etc.
conduct regular field visits to identify major cereal crop diseases such as leaf spot, leaf blight, anthracnose, Powdery mildew, root rot, rust, yellow mosaic, etc.
determine the stage of pest and disease incidence along with the extent of damage and economic threshold levels (ETL) of the pests
co-ordinate with the agricultural extension service agents and diagnostic clinics to determine the causal organism for the disease and its treatment

modules.module_title: Identify and apply the necessary treatment

pcs.pc_description: identify natural enemies of the cereal pests such as ladybird, ground beetles, hoverfly and adopt them for pest control according to the advice of agricultural extension workers, Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), diagnostic clinics, etc.
apply the recommended treatment as per the prescription to remove pests and disease
follow the recommended safety practices while applying any treatment, such as using the relevant PPE
maintain the record of the use of any pesticides, insecticides and any other treatment

pcs.pc_description: collect a water sample from the source of irrigation and coordinate with an authorised lab to get it tested
follow the measures recommended by the lab to improve the water quality
set up an appropriate irrigation system such as surface irrigation, drip irrigation, sub-surface irrigation system based on the requirement of the specific field crop

modules.module_title: Irrigate the field

pcs.pc_description: irrigate the field according to the recommended irrigation schedule for the crop, ensuring there is adequate water supply at various stages of crop’s growth
maintain the record of field irrigation to ensure irrigation as per the schedule
follow the recommended practices to prevent over and under-irrigation, ensuring there is no waterlogging at any stage of the crop’s growth

modules.module_title: Manage the water usage

pcs.pc_description: follow the recommended practices for effective drainage of excess water from the field
maintain the recommended level of water in the soil to prevent the harmful effects of inappropriate levels of moisture in it
plug water spills and leakages to prevent its wastage
use efficient irrigation techniques to minimize water waste and conserve resources
integrate water-saving irrigation practices like drip irrigation and rainwater harvesting

modules.module_title: Harvest the cereal crop

pcs.pc_description: check the maturity of the cereal crop to ensure its readiness for being harvested
select the manual or mechanical harvesting method according to the quantity of the crop to be harvested
arrange the necessary tools, equipment and machinery for harvesting cereal crop and prepare them for use
select an appropriate time for harvesting the crop to maintain the required moisture level
harvest the crop, ensuring minimum loss

modules.module_title: Process and pack the cereals

pcs.pc_description: check the harvested cereals for biological infestation and physical damage, and segregate the infested and damaged cereals
sort the harvested cereals on the applicable parameters such as quality, colour, size and appearance
carry out threshing or winnowing of the harvested cereal crop to loosen the grain seed from the husk or separate grain from the chaff, as applicable

pack the cereals following the relevant packaging standards and label the packs with the necessary information as per the applicable regulatory requirements
weigh the packed cereals to ensure correct weight in the packs and seal them

apply the recommended treatment in the storage area to remove pests and rodents and store the packed cereals safely

select an appropriate time for selling cereals based on the periodical demand of the produce and profitability
identify the appropriate market and buyers for cereals, such as eMandi, procurement agencies, local traders, co-operatives, exporters, etc.
coordinate and negotiate with the buyer to secure a profitable price for the produce
arrange an appropriate mode of transport to deliver cereals to the buyer in a hygienic and safe condition
process the payment using the buyer- preferred e-payment method
calculate the benefit-cost (B:C) ratio
maintain the record of sales and payments manually and/ or electronically using the physical registers and/ or the relevant computer application

prepare the field for sowing and apply basal fertiliser in the recommended dose

pcs.pc_description: irrigate the wheat crop with the recommended quantity of water as per the irrigation schedule
apply pre-emergent and post-emergent herbicides to the crop, as required

modules.module_title: Raise rice seedlings in the nursery

pcs.pc_description: prepare the nursery bed and apply the recommended manure and fertilisers to it in the recommended quantity
ensure the availability of quality water in the required quantity and create irrigation channels to supply water in the nursery
broadcast seeds/ sprouted seeds as per the seed rate recommended for the selected variety of rice
grow seedlings in trays as per recommended mechanised procedure, such as the use of paddy transplanter
perform weed control in the nursery bed
apply the recommended pesticides and fungicides as per the requirement in the nursery bed to protect the seedlings from pests and diseases
harvest the seedlings at the recommended stage for transplantation in the rice field, ensuring the suitability of the selected rice variety to the field soil

modules.module_title: Prepare the field and transplant the seedlings

pcs.pc_description: carry out ploughing, harrowing and levelling in the rice field to obtain the required tilth
apply the recommended fertilisers to the field as per the basal fertiliser application technique
puddle the field to stop leeching and destroy weeds
level the field after puddling to use irrigation/ rainwater efficiently
transplant the rice seedlings in the field, maintaining the recommended space between the rows for intercultural operations
follow the practices recommended as per the System of Rice Intensification (SRI) for an improved yield

modules.module_title: Carry out the Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) method

pcs.pc_description: prepare the land using laser leveling or manual methods to ensure a flat field
prepare the soil with minimal tillage in dry fields or puddling in wet fields, depending on the DSR type (dry or wet).
apply pre-sowing herbicides like glyphosate to clear existing weeds
use certified, high-yield, and short-duration rice varieties suitable for DSR
treat seeds with fungicides and bio- inoculants to prevent seed-borne diseases and promote healthy germination
sow seeds at appropriate time and as per the recommended seed rate for the selected variety using appropriate sowing method
wet the field lightly before sowing in dry DSR; for wet DSR, maintain a shallow water level until germination.
keep the soil moist but avoid waterlogging during early growth stages.
use Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) to save water while maintaining yields

modules.module_title: Maintain the rice crop

pcs.pc_description: irrigate the rice crop with the recommended quantity of water according to the stages of its growth
apply pre-emergent and post-emergent herbicides, if applicable
apply the recommended fertilisers in the prescribed dose according to the stages of growth of the rice crop
identify the signs of infestation by various pests and diseases in the rice crop, such as leaf/ neck blast, sheath blight, spots, stem borer, leaf folder, etc.
undertake dipping of paddy seedlings as per the recommended procedure for plant protection
apply the recommended treatment such as pesticides and insecticides as per the prescription

modules.module_title: Carry out harvesting, post-harvest management and marketing of rice crop

select the appropriate harvesting method such as manual cutting and threshing or mechanical method involving the use of a combine harvester depending on the field size and availability of resources
harvest and thresh the paddy
select an appropriate packing material for the rice crop such as jute bags and store the packed rice in a hygienic storage area, maintaining the recommended temperature and humidity
manage stubble according to the recommended stubble management methods to improve the soil fertility
select an appropriate time for marketing the harvested rice crop according to the market demand
undertake marketing of rice crop at a profitable price after negotiating with the buyer(s)
arrange for safe and hygienic delivery of rice crop to the buyer(s)
